description: The file defines a sealed class 'SocketConnectionListenerFactory' implementing IConnectionListenerFactory, responsible for creating and binding socket connection listeners within Orleans networking infrastructure. It uses dependency injection for options, logging, and schedulers, and creates instances of 'SocketConnectionListener'.

classes.name: SocketConnectionListenerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating socket connection listeners based on provided configuration options and dependencies, and exposing BindAsync method to initiate listening on specified network end points.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket connection listener to the specified endpoint, returning it wrapped in a ValueTask.
